beats.event: Mr Earnshaw brings the foundling Heathcliff home from Liverpool
Hindley resents the favoured intruder and beats him
Heathcliff and Catherine roam the moors as inseparable companions
Mr Earnshaw dies; Hindley returns as master and reduces him to a farm hand
The Lintons take in the injured Catherine at Thrushcross Grange
Catherine accepts Edgar Linton's proposal of marriage
Heathcliff overhears her say marrying him would degrade her; vanishes
Three years later he returns to Wuthering Heights, wealthy and refined
He elopes with Edgar's sister Isabella to spite the Lintons
Buys Hindley out; the drunkard Hindley soon dies and Heathcliff owns the Heights
Catherine dies giving birth to young Cathy; Heathcliff begs her ghost to haunt him
Isabella flees south and bears his sickly son Linton Heathcliff
He forces young Cathy to marry the dying Linton to seize the Grange
Linton dies; Cathy is left trapped and mistreated at the Heights
Young Cathy and Hareton grow close; his grip on the next generation slips
Obsessed with the dead Catherine, he stops eating and dies in her old room
